title: lifeiyuAAA-Brown GUI
description: The  Low Brightness Brown GUI Resource Pack For Minecraft:Java Edition.It did not change the item of Minecraft. Just changing Minecraft UI
body:
# **Introduction**
BrownGUI is a resource pack with a medium to low brightness red ceramic theme. It can avoid the problem of a bright UI when playing Minecraft at night, and also prevent the UI from being unclear during the day. If you want a new experience, you can try this resource pack. It did not change the item of Minecraft.
# **Feature**
1. Low Brightness
2. Red Ceramic Theme
3. It looks like chocolate!



# **Mod Compatibility**
1. trashSlot
2. appleskin

(Currently compatible with a small number of mods, but I will still be compatible with other mods in the future)
# **Report issues**
If you encounter any problems during the gameplay, please feel free to contact me. For contact information, please refer to the text file.
